queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Company names, 9-digit SIREN numbers or 14-digit SIRET numbers (spaces allowed). A SIREN/SIRET returns exactly that company; a name returns ranked search results.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per name query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Companies returned per name search (1-100). Set to 1 for single best-match mode: only a confident name match is returned, otherwise the query is reported as not found (and not charged). Ignored for SIREN/SIRET lookups.

postalCode.title: Postal code filter
postalCode.description: Name searches only: 5-digit French postal code of an establishment, e.g. 75008. Comma-separated list allowed.

department.title: Department filter
department.description: Name searches only: department code, e.g. 75, 69, 2A, 971. Comma-separated list allowed.

nafCode.title: NAF / APE activity code filter
nafCode.description: Name searches only: main activity code (NAF rev. 2), e.g. 62.01Z. Comma-separated list allowed.

onlyActive.title: Only active companies
onlyActive.description: Name searches only: skip ceased companies. SIREN/SIRET lookups always return the company with its is_active flag.

minEmployeeRange.title: Minimum employee range
minEmployeeRange.description: Name searches only: keep companies whose INSEE headcount band is at least this size.
